definePluginEntry provides register with an OpenClawPluginApi parameter. The four registration calls are API members; the provider descriptors, request/config objects, transport callbacks, and capability context are not API or PluginRuntime handles. There are no named hook registrations or runtime-member findings.

Explicit Pick/index projections add type-reference, parameter destructuring adds member-access, and direct alias invocation adds call. The context declarations/construction prove the same underlying functions, so these documented focused facades identify the implicit dependencies. Equivalent reexports in ssrf-runtime, security-runtime, agent-harness-runtime, or realtime-transcription do not establish additional plugin references. Retain one focused export identity per context-provided function, with no invented import kind/module site and no enumeration of equivalent barrel aliases. Explicit plugin imports elsewhere retain their actual specifier identity.

Aliases readRecord, readFiniteNumber, and trimToUndefined resolve to asOptionalRecord, parseFiniteNumber, and normalizeOptionalString.

MAX_AUDIO_BYTES has its syntactic import dependency; a bare value read adds no reference kind.
